Container.Name: commet-unraid
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Commet Matrix web client (official upstream web release, PGP-verified at build). Client only—connects to external Matrix homeservers. Session data stays in your browser. Enable TLS for browser crypto (E2EE). Optional DEFAULT_HOMESERVER pre-fills the login screen.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: HTTP port (redirects to HTTPS when TLS is enabled)

Config.Name: Web UI SSL Port
Config.Description: HTTPS port for the Commet web UI

Config.Name: DEFAULT_HOMESERVER
Config.Description: Default Matrix homeserver hostname (for example matrix.example.com). Maps to Commet global_config.json.

Config.Name: TLS_SELF_SIGNED
Config.Description: Generate a self-signed certificate on first start if no cert is mounted in /etc/nginx/ssl

Config.Name: TLS_HOSTNAME
Config.Description: Certificate CN/SAN when using TLS_SELF_SIGNED (use the hostname you type in the browser)

Config.Name: TLS_PUBLIC_PORT
Config.Description: Host HTTPS port used in HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects (match Web UI SSL Port)

Config.Name: TLS Certificate Storage
Config.Description: Persist generated or mounted TLS certificate and key
